chart_family: Gujarat municipal 5-digit budget/account code (BPMC/GPMC Act regime; NMAM-influenced)
basis: accrual (municipal), reported in budget books in rupees lakh

source.primary: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation Budget for Year 2023-24 (English edition)
source.corroboration: same code slots recur identically across AMC books 2005-06 → 2026-27 (verified by sevent4; sevent4/memory/verified_facts.md, head 23306)

authority_manual_status: NOT YET ACQUIRED. The de-jure authority is the Gujarat Municipal Finance Board (GMFB) — the nodal agency the Govt of Gujarat appointed to move all municipalities to accrual double-entry accounting; the formal Gujarat municipal accounts manual sits with GMFB / Urban Development Dept (not cleanly web-downloadable as of 2026-06-27; portal/ahara follow-on). Here the AMC published budget book is the de-facto code list in use. Confirm parent-head names against the GMFB manual when acquired (REQ-0001).

major_group.name: Non-tax revenue income
major_group.source_note: AMC's own revenue-income abstract (Budget 2023-24, final page) groups these under 'Non-tax revenue income', beside tax heads, octroi-grant (18133), and 'Revenue grant subsidy/contribution'.

heads.name: Penalty Recovered from Suppliers
heads.note: TWIN of 23306; easy to conflate when summing.

heads.name: Penalty Recovered from Contractors
heads.note: REQ-0001 target. Generic, city-wide; booked under many departments (Audit, Finance, Record Office, Central Stores, Workshop, Census, ...). Published actuals run in the crores/year, not near-zero.

heads.name: SRFDCL
heads.note: Sabarmati Riverfront Development Corporation Ltd-related receipt (expand on manual).

related_head_outside_group.name: Govt. Grant in lieu of Octroi
related_head_outside_group.note: State->city compensation transfer; NOT non-tax. AMC's largest 'from above' line (~Rs 1,194 cr BE 2023-24). The vertical fund-flow worked example. See notes/fund_flow_map.md.

consolidation_rule.structure: The AMC budget book is a department x budget-head matrix. The department code (e.g. 102 Audit, 104 Muni. Commissioner's Office) is the revenue centre; the 5-digit account code (e.g. 23306) is the nature of the receipt.
consolidation_rule.city_total_for_a_head: Sum of that head's line across ALL departments. There is NO single published city-total line for an individual code like 23306; AMC publishes only the rolled-up 'Non-tax revenue income' aggregate in its abstract.
consolidation_rule.caveat: A precise per-code city series must be summed from per-department lines; naive pdftotext summing under-captures department rows (sevent4 saw 1315 vs 2630 lakh for 2016-17 from two extractions). Use the abstract aggregate as the upper sanity bound.

column_layout_clean_english_books: 7 numeric columns, rupees lakh: actual(Y-3), actual(Y-2), BE(Y-1), RE(Y-1), proposed(Y), standing-committee(Y), board(Y). Confirmed by cross-book chaining (col2 of book Y = col1 of book Y+1).
consumer: sevent4 (The Unelected City) — looks up AMC budget-line codes against this reference to label heads and apply the department->city-head roll-up. REQ-0001 in _org/requests/LEDGER.md.
